runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before your Christmas Run in Memphis.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick runner checklist for wave starts, race-day bibs, swag delivery, timing, and final course details.

items.label: Wave starts
items.detail: Open the official race page and use its wave-time email/contact guidance to request a wave. Waves are filled first come, first served and include Wave A at 7:30 AM, Wave B at 8:00 AM, and Wave C at 8:30 AM.

items.label: Course map
items.detail: Plan around the Riverwalk start area. Course maps and final race details are sent in the final update email the Wednesday before race day.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.detail: No packet pickup is required: swag ships to the address used at registration, and race bibs are provided on race day.

items.label: Timing
items.detail: This is a stress-free run with no timing chips; runners keep track of their own time.

items.label: Included swag
items.detail: The swag bag includes a running T-shirt shipped to the registration address, finisher's towel or giveaway, finisher's medal, digital training pack, online results/certificate, and local running club invitation.

items.label: Late registration
items.value: Shirt may arrive after race day
items.detail: For registrations within two weeks of the race, shirts may arrive after the run because shipping takes time.

story.title: Jingle all the way through a Memphis holiday race morning.
paragraphs: A Merry Christmas Run brings runners and families together the day after Christmas for a festive Memphis race morning with 5K, 10K, family mile, virtual, and eco-registration options.

The event is framed around holiday togetherness — spreading love, giving selflessly, and sharing the joy of Christmas with family, friends, and fellow runners before the rest of the day’s festivities.

The runner experience is intentionally low-friction: swag ships to the registration address, bibs are provided on race day, course maps and final details arrive by email, and the run is positioned as stress-free rather than chip-timed.

faqs.question: What events are offered?
faqs.answer: Event options include 5K Registration, 10K Registration, Virtual Run Registration, Family 1 Mile Fun Run, and 5K/10K/13.1 Eco-Registration (No Shirt).

faqs.question: Where is the race?
faqs.answer: The race starts from the Riverwalk area in Memphis, TN 38103. Course maps are emailed before race day.

faqs.question: When do waves start?
faqs.answer: Wave A starts at 7:30 AM, Wave B at 8:00 AM, and Wave C at 8:30 AM. Runners can request their desired wave time by email.

faqs.question: Is the race chip-timed?
faqs.answer: No. This is a stress-free run with no timing chips, so participants can keep track of their own time.

faqs.question: Is packet pickup required?
faqs.answer: No packet pickup is required. Swag ships to the registration address, and race bibs are provided on race day.

faqs.question: What happens if I register late?
faqs.answer: Shirts for registrations within two weeks of race day will likely arrive after the run because shipping takes time.
